item.title: n2-004 - An exciting trip
item.description: 课文 Paraphrase 复述 语法 [[present-perfect-tense|现在完成时]] Vocabulary Expression 难点 1. receive and take receive 接收 - I have just received a letter from my brother. 我从弟弟那里收到一封信。 take 拿走 - Someone has taken my pen away. 有人拿走了我的钢笔。
